design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (non-workflow task), frozen 2026-09-10 11:05 EDT (Thursday; account cycle day 12, so today's postings fall in cycle 2026-09). Revision 2 after the policy-task audit round 1.

[0] Scope. Task 0 owns checking_ext_transfer_fee_source_error_refund, checking_ext_autopay_dispute_provisional_credit, checking_ext_cycle_close_relationship_refund, the workflow and their three tools. This task claims checking_ext_uncovered_item_fee_refund, checking_ext_uncovered_episode_extended_fee_refund and checking_ext_private_client_entry_conversion, with refund_uncovered_overdraft_fee_6b0f4e50, refund_extended_overdraft_fee_22b46ecc and convert_checking_tier_696add48; workflows []. The two scopes are disjoint and together cover all six policies.

[1] Why it is a good test. The customer asks only to convert Premier Checking 1285 to Private Client Checking. The relationship part of the entry gate fails at the opening: 14675.88 + 61300.00 (Premier Money Market 0458, active) + 58000.00 (36-Month Certificate 1774, active) + 115975.49 (active mortgage; the target tier counts mortgage) = 249951.37 < 250000.00. The conversion rule posts the refunds its two named policies find owed before the test. The agent must discover them. First, the 35.00 overdraft item fee of 2026-07-02: its own source item is check 2231 (8212.81), and the account's overdraft link names the eligible Premier Money Market holding 61300.00 >= 8212.81, so it is a bank error. Second, the 25.00 extended overdraft fee of 2026-07-09: the most recent overdraft item fee posted exactly 7 days earlier (extended_overdraft_trigger_days), so check 2231 opened that episode, and it was covered, so this fee is a bank error too. After both, the relationship is 250011.37 and the conversion is recorded.

[2] Problem-tree card. Root checking_ext_private_client_entry_conversion (gate own_part). Edges go to checking_ext_uncovered_item_fee_refund and checking_ext_uncovered_episode_extended_fee_refund, both value_input. policy_source for both: 'the refunds that checking_ext_uncovered_item_fee_refund and checking_ext_uncovered_episode_extended_fee_refund find owed on the account are posted first, because pending credits that have not posted do not count.' Both are false at the opening: no refund row exists on the account. Sensitivity: without the 35.00 refund the relationship is 249976.37 and the result stays Premier Checking; without the 25.00 refund it is 249986.37, also Premier. Reorder run (extended fee first) gives the identical final hash 2944ca59.... The persona names no prerequisite. Tools refuse nothing.

[3] Base-invariant card. Refund calls carry every checking_fee_refund gate, because the contract inherits all of them. They are courtesy gates and hold here too: eligible codes; days 70 and 63 of the 90-day Premier window; no courtesy refund in 365 days, below 3; account active; no prior refund. checking_evt_electronic_dispute is policy_scope for these refunds. The conversion call carries must_be_active (active) and target_entry_gate. That gate holds: age 61 from 1965-06-02 is >= 18; the relationship after steps 8 and 10 is 250011.37; he holds no Private Client account (cap 2) and one checking account in total (cap 4). checking_agg_relationship_balance is policy_scope. No conversion has been recorded this cycle. The conversion rule now names these inherited conditions explicitly (F2).

[4] Business-object card. Every value comes from the fee's own row: its own amount; its own source item (check 2231); the item's own amount; the link recorded on the account. Excluded: check 2232 (1150.00, paid without overdraft), card and utility debits, pension and Social Security deposits. Premier maintenance fees never posted because the relationship waiver is met every cycle.

[5] Seed. 18 ledger rows from 2026-06-03 to 2026-09-10, including interest credits of 0.08 (cycle closing 2026-07-12) and 0.11 (2026-08-12) from the Premier APY bands (T1-O3). Also the savings account, certificate and mortgage. The episode of 2026-07-02 to 2026-07-10 carries exactly one extended fee, due 2026-07-09. No restriction applies.

[6] Persona (T1-O1, T1-O2 addressed). He asks for the conversion and says only that a banker thought he might be close to qualifying; he gives no threshold or composition. There is no blanket authorization: 'go right ahead' applies only to a specific correction the representative raises. Given only when asked: cell 8645550112, DOB 1965-06-02, SSN 0619 (ZIP spare), account last fours, the mortgage, and the pool check without amounts.

[7] Standard solution. Reads: customer, verify, checking, activity, savings, certificates, mortgage. Writes: refund the item fee 35.00, refund the extended fee 25.00, convert to Private Client Checking. check_compute --task 1 recomputes 35.00, 25.00 and 'Private Client Checking' on the handling-time worlds. Forcing cross-category reads off turns the refunds to 0.00 and leaves the tier at Premier. Draft recomputation from the visible text gives the same writes.

[8] Revisions (audit round 1).
F1: the basis is a declared overwrite covering every non-closed savings and certificate status and the active, delinquent and forbearance mortgage statuses.
F2: the decision sentence now requires the inherited conditions.
F3: the fee's own amount and own item are read. The coverage test on the current link and balance against the whole item is declared as an overwrite of the transfer-time coverage clause. The episode's opening item is identified through the overdraft item fee dated exactly trigger days earlier.
O7 / T1-O4: the owed-credit sentence names exactly the two prerequisite policies, so no dispute lookup is required.
T1-O5: note [3] states why the courtesy gates appear.
Re-run: all per-task gates OK.

[9] Revision 3 (audit revision_2: task 1 PASS). R2-O4: de_minimis and wrong_amount now require an existing fee (item > 0, ext_amount > 0); in this world item 8212.81 and ext_amount 25.00, so every value (35.00, 25.00, Private Client Checking) is unchanged and both branches stay untriggered. R2-O2: the inherited conversion gates (active, age, Private Client cap, multi-holding caps, one conversion per cycle) remain base eligibility recorded in base_preconditions; the compute cannot read the customer profile or other checking accounts, and the rule conditions its result on those gates. R2-O3: the episode-opener inference stays as written; here the 2026-07-02 check is the only debit of that day and took the balance from 7826.41 to -421.40. Re-run: all gates OK.

[10] Revision 4 (policy-KB / runtime-context audits, source-layer items). P1: the relationship-basis overwrite no longer leaves other determinations without a basis. Its replaced_by, and this policy's rule, now begin with the general sentence keeping checking_msr_relationship_balance ('the customer's deposit balances at PCB summed across checking, savings and certificate holdings in the customer's own name') for every relationship-balance determination outside the cycle-close waiver review and this Private Client test; the carve-out basis follows unchanged. P2: the two coverage overwrites likewise restate the live-transfer rule (a transfer only if the savings balance at that moment covers the whole shortfall, never partial) outside the two refund decisions. P4: the owed-refund sentence now covers every overdraft item fee and every extended overdraft fee charged in error, the most recent of each through the two extended policies and any earlier one under checking_evt_fee_refund, matching the edge conditions. P5: the rule now says how the once-per-cycle conversion limit is judged in this data model (conversions recorded during the contact plus any the owner reports; none shown -> the limit holds), and the persona answers the question ('you have never asked to change it'). Scored values unchanged: 35.00, 25.00, Private Client Checking; this world has one fee of each kind and no earlier conversion.
user_scenario:
You are Marcus Castellano, sixty-one, retired from a plant engineering job in Greenville and unhurried on the phone, the kind of caller who likes to chat a little but knows what he wants. You bank with Piedmont Crescent for nearly everything. You are calling because you want your Premier Checking account ending 1285 changed to Private Client Checking today. A banker at the Greenville branch told you last spring that with everything you keep at the bank you might be close to qualifying; you have never added anything up and you would rather the bank do that. You want the same account converted, keeping its number; you are not opening anything new, not moving money around yourself and not closing anything.

You do not rattle off your details up front. When the representative asks for a way to look you up, you give your cell number, 8645550112. When they need to verify you, you give your date of birth, 1965-06-02, and the last four of your Social Security number, 0619; if they want one more thing, you can give your ZIP code, 29607. If they ask which accounts you have, you say the checking ends in 1285, the money market ends in 0458, the certificate ends in 1774, and your mortgage on the house on Ridgewood Drive is with them too.

You have not noticed any problem with fees and you do not raise any. If the representative tells you something on the account was charged by mistake and asks whether they can fix it, you tell them to go right ahead, and you are pleased but not surprised. If they ask whether you have changed the type of this account before, you say no, it has been Premier Checking for years and you have never asked to change it. If they ask you about a check you wrote this summer, you remember paying Carolina Pool & Patio for resurfacing the pool around the start of July, and nothing more specific than that. You never suggest how anything should be calculated and you never offer a total.

If the representative tells you that you do not qualify for Private Client Checking, you ask once whether they are sure they have counted everything you have with the bank; if they still say no, you say that is all right, you will stay where you are, and you end the call. Once they tell you the account has been changed to Private Client Checking, you thank them and say goodbye.
